user.title: Energy Cost Stats
user.description: Choose the time zone used for tariff zones and groupings, and the largest hourly consumption (per device) that is still considered plausible. Energy sensors are selected afterwards in the integration options.

data_description.time_zone: Used for tariff zones and daily, weekly and monthly groupings. It does not follow later changes of the Home Assistant time zone.
data_description.spike_check: Flag hours with implausibly high consumption in the data-quality report.
data_description.spike_limit: Maximum plausible consumption per device and hour. Ignored when the spike check is off.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Cost Stats is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

error.invalid_limit: The spike limit must be a number greater than 0.

init.title: Energy Cost Stats options
init.description: Select the energy sensors to report on and adjust the global settings.

data_description.time_zone: Used for tariff zones and daily, weekly and monthly groupings.
data_description.spike_check: Flag hours with implausibly high consumption in the data-quality report.
data_description.spike_limit: Maximum plausible consumption per device and hour. Ignored when the spike check is off.
data_description.edit_device_limits: Open an extra step to set a different spike limit for individual sensors.

device_limits.title: Per-device spike limits
device_limits.description: Leave empty to use the global limit, 0 turns the check off for this device.

error.not_energy_entity: Only sensors with device class energy can be selected.
error.invalid_limit: Enter a finite number (greater than 0 for the global limit, 0 or more for a device).

abort.invalid_options: The stored options are invalid. Remove and add the integration again.

user.title: Add tariff plan
user.description: Start from a preset or copy an existing plan.

preset.title: Choose a preset
preset.description: The zones of the plan follow the preset. You enter the prices and check the hours in the next step.

copy.title: Copy a plan
copy.description: Names, prices and hours are copied; you set a new start date.

plan.title: Tariff plan
plan.description:
Every hour of the day must belong to exactly one zone. Enter hours as HH:MM-HH:MM on whole hours. Changing a plan re-prices all past hours it covers.

{detail}

data_description.valid_from: The plan applies from local midnight of this date until the next plan starts. Hours before the first plan are reported as unpriced.
data_description.name: Display name of the plan.
data_description.t0_name: Display name only; the zone key stays the same.
data_description.t0_price: Price per kWh, for example 10.30 (a comma works too).
data_description.t0_periods: Whole hours as HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas, for example 07:00-10:00, 17:00-21:00. Use 23:00-07:00 across midnight and 00:00-24:00 for the whole day.
data_description.t1_name: Display name only; the zone key stays the same.
data_description.t1_price: Price per kWh, for example 10.30 (a comma works too).
data_description.t1_periods: Whole hours as HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas, for example 07:00-10:00, 17:00-21:00. Use 23:00-07:00 across midnight and 00:00-24:00 for the whole day.
data_description.t2_name: Display name only; the zone key stays the same.
data_description.t2_price: Price per kWh, for example 10.30 (a comma works too).
data_description.t2_periods: Whole hours as HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas, for example 07:00-10:00, 17:00-21:00. Use 23:00-07:00 across midnight and 00:00-24:00 for the whole day.
data_description.t3_name: Display name only; the zone key stays the same.
data_description.t3_price: Price per kWh, for example 10.30 (a comma works too).
data_description.t3_periods: Whole hours as HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas, for example 07:00-10:00, 17:00-21:00. Use 23:00-07:00 across midnight and 00:00-24:00 for the whole day.

error.invalid_price: Enter a price as a plain number, for example 10.30.
error.invalid_periods: Enter whole hours as HH:MM-HH:MM, separated by commas, for example 07:00-23:00.
error.blank_name: The name must not be empty.
error.valid_from_taken: Another plan already starts on this date.

abort.unknown_plan: The selected plan no longer exists.
abort.invalid_plan_data: The stored plan is invalid. Delete it and add it again.
